semiconductor_relevance: High — QuantumDiamonds focuses on semiconductor testing and yield optimization through quantum sensing technologies.
summary: QuantumDiamonds is a startup that leverages synthetic diamonds for quantum sensing to enhance semiconductor testing and yield optimization. With a multidisciplinary team, the company aims to set new industry standards and improve the efficiency of semiconductor production through non-destructive, high-precision measurement techniques.
capabilities: Quantum sensing technology for semiconductor testing

regional_presence.Europe: The company has received support from European funding and is based in Bavaria, Germany.
